summary: 16 features and 2 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • data-management: add save context to overview DTOs (386a7a6)
  • save-management: add save catalog and activation endpoints (dcf74d0)
  • controllers: update sessions and system controllers (f02e2a9)
  • frontend: update frontend config and platform options (9df22a7)
  • providers: add auto-retry support to AI providers (d692329)
  • retry: add retryable failure classifiers and status chunk factory (a9e3739)
  • git: add lightweight status summary for ProjectGitGrain (1fd56e9)
  • avatar: add shared custom avatar library with grain storage (61dd713)
  • dlc: add DLC access state grain and controller (9c5dc74)

HagiCode-org/web

  • git: enhance PathDisplay with signature status (d8d74b8)
  • saveManagement: add save catalog panel and management (f80718e)
  • dataManagement: refactor settings tab after import/export removal (e5e39b6)
  • git: improve Git components with turbo engine integration (07fed8a)
  • settings: add brand customization and improve error retry settings (8226801)
  • hero: add shared avatar management and reorder functionality (812c59c)
  • dlc: add turbo engine DLC access state management (28bd8bb)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • migration: use correct save layout for migration operations (9143f99)

HagiCode-org/web

  • conversation: correct generation state type handling (33d7591)
